title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: charging the premium of a bound cover
content:
## Situation of use

This entry belongs to the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line. It applies when the premium of a bound cover is charged. The premium is worked out on the insured value fixed when the cover is bound, so a quoted cover is bound before its premium is charged, and a bound cover whose premium has not been charged owes that charge.

## Entry condition

The cover is active and its insured value has been fixed at binding under the insured-value rule for binding before the premium is built up.

## Scope boundary

This entry governs the premium of a cover whose premium is settled after binding. A premium that the cover eligibility rules require to be received before binding, because the holder's credit status is cash in advance and the product requires prepayment, is outside this entry.

## What the tool does

One call of charge_cover_premium_8ce00127 books one premium charge entry on the cover's premium and settlement account, dated today, and raises the cover's unpaid premium balance by the amount charged. Nothing is paid and the cover's status is unchanged. On success the cover holder can be told the premium charged and the premium now due.

## How it is invoked

charge_cover_premium_8ce00127 is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the desk agent.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| cover_id | Cover reference number of the cover whose premium is charged, as returned by the cover lookup | Identifier |
| amount_usd | Premium charged | US dollars, a non-negative number with 2 decimal places; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |

## Return

On success the tool returns: status ("charged" when the premium entry was booked); premium_event_id (reference of the new premium charge entry); cover_id; amount_usd (USD with 2 decimal places, as booked); premium_due_usd (the cover's unpaid premium after the charge, USD with 2 decimal places).

## Basis Q&A

**Does charging the premium collect it?** No. The call raises the unpaid premium balance; nothing is paid.

**A cover was bound yesterday and no premium charge appears on it. Is a charge owed?** Yes. A bound cover whose premium has not been charged owes that charge.
